verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: soraThaa: brahamaasan bisraam gur bhe gurmukh sa(n)dh mil ||

en.bdb: Sorath: Satguru who resides in Waheguru (Brahm), meeting such Guru-conscious person (Guru Amar Das), and becoming one with him he too acquired all traits of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh ramataa raam raam naam gurmukh bhe ||

en.bdb: Through the blessings of Naam Simran of the principal Guru Satguru (Amar Das Ji), Guru Ram Das Ji too became prime Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਰਾ: ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਿਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheharaa: gur bhe gurmukh sa(n)idh mil brahamaasan bisraam ||

en.bdb: Dohra: In the association of prime Guru (Guru Amar Das Ji) he too became Guru and found refuge in the holy feet of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit_en: raam naam gurmukh bhe gurmukh ramataa raam ||

en.bdb: The Guru-conscious person whose name is Ram Das, by perpetual meditation on Lord's name, became Guru-oriented and virtuous (Satguru)

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: gurmukh ramataa raam naam gurmukh pragaTaio ||

en.bdb: Channt: Through God-conscious Guru Amar Das Ji and by the blessing of meditation on His name, the virtuous Ram Das emerged as Guru Ram Das (slave of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat gur giaan dhiaan gur guroo kahaio ||

en.bdb: Because of knowledge of Guru Shabad and consciously uniting with Him, Guru Ram Das became known as principal Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheep jot mil dheep jot jagamag a(n)tar ur ||

en.bdb: The flame of a beacon lights up another lamp.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਧਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh ramataa raam sa(n)dh gurmukh mil bhe gur ||5||

en.bdb: Thus Guru Ram Das became principal Guru through the blessings of Simran of Lord's name and his association with Guru Amar Das Ji. (5)
